stone-brick-wall-001.stats: 5 maps, all 2048x2048 8-bit JPEG: diff (albedo RGB), nor_gl (OpenGL normal RGB), rough, ao, disp (grayscale). Set 4.39 MB; folder 4.46 MB incl. license+manifest. Grey cut-block (ashlar) castle masonry - large rectangular stones in deep mortar, aged and weathered; Poly Haven tags: stones, bricks, blocks, castle, fort, dungeon, dark.
stone-brick-wall-001.why: Closest match to 'grey gothic masonry ashlar' of everything reviewed; believable stone (no toy/cartoon read); tiny 4.4 MB footprint is ideal for Intel integrated graphics.
stone-brick-wall-001.gaps: Material only: no modular pieces, trim sheets, decals, windows or arches; no color variants; 8-bit JPEG displacement (parallax/vertex use, not export quality); one fixed block scale - UV scale must be set per wall.

The other four sets' disp maps are true mode=L. No effect on use.

stone-tiles-02.name: Stone Tiles 02
stone-tiles-02.author: Charlotte Baglioni
stone-tiles-02.stats: 5 maps, all 2048x2048 8-bit JPEG: diff, nor_gl, rough, ao, disp. Set 12.52 MB; folder 12.59 MB incl. license+manifest. Grey flagstone/stone-tile floor of uneven hand-laid slabs; tags: uneven, rock, stones, stone, floor, tiles, slates.

sinestesia-2d-explosions.gaps: No FPS stated; realistic rendered look may need grading to match the grounded-fantasy style; explosion 1 is a small spark burst with a long sparse tail; no lightning/shield/energy-streak content; CC0 sequels #2 and #3 and the 4096 full-size atlases were not downloaded (budget).
sinestesia-2d-explosions.verifier_note: The page-level 'Copyright/Attribution Notice' ('please mention us ... leave a like') is a non-binding polite request under CC0 - no legal attribution owed. Claim that 'explosion 4 is two-phase' is not clearly supported by my coverage curve (single rise then decay); keep as weak.

calinou-lightning.name: Lightning (11 CC0 bolt textures)
calinou-lightning.author: Calinou
calinou-lightning.stats: 11 PNG bolt textures, 1024x512, RGB (no alpha, black background), 417 KB total; visually confirmed clean branching horizontal bolts.

calinou-lightning.gaps: Static textures, not a temporal sequence; no alpha channel (must key black or use additive blending); horizontal orientation only (rotate in shader); realistic blue-white palette, needs magic tinting.

KayKit's module is 4 units (not metres), so the Phase 2 unit decision applies: at the repo's current root_scale=1.0 the standard stair rises 5.1 units, and a 1.75-1.90 m character needs the agreed global scale. Does NOT include: potted plants, a suit of armour, a real multi-arm chandelier, or benches. Each .gltf needs its same-named .bin buffer beside it.
